metadata.compiler: GCC13.3 O3 LTO for C/C++ resamplers and drivers; FFTW static Debian archive prebuilt
metadata.input_notes: Each float32 stereo WAV has >=30 seconds deterministic multitone+noise content rounded to whole reference blocks, plus one common zero block to drain reference overlap. Same file for every implementation.
metadata.timing_notes: Process CPU time; WAV IO/load, source format conversion, symbol loading and output validation excluded. Setup reported separately. Processing includes result collection and FAAR flushing; reference overlap drains via common zero input. ARDFTSRC output remains double internally until excluded WAV saving; FAAR public output float32.
metadata.memory_notes: Peak RSS includes entire input/output and IO-library buffers, not isolated streaming state. FAAR create_heap delta is net glibc live heap across create only.

reference_setup_heap_control.measurement: One additional run per conversion; net glibc mallinfo2(uordblks+hblkhd) before/after setup, after input matrix creation. These runs are NOT part of CPU timing samples. Net live allocation, not peak allocation.
